title: Late-January health-law strike call and the cancelled 1 February national action
notes: January E010 concerns an announced late-January strike, not a verified assembly. Sirmes Oruro announced a 24-hour strike for 1 February (S033), while Los Tiempos reports the national Colegio Médico action was suspended that morning after an agreement (S010); whether the Oruro call executed remains unknown. After Law 1359 was promulgated on 17 February, CONASA called a new strike from 18 February (S034), and dated street marches are documented from 22 February onward. These facts do not establish a continuous January-to-February episode or January public action. February owns only the evidenced February assemblies pending coordinator review.

title: New 15-day health-strike call after the scheduled 28 February end of the first wave
notes: Correo del Sur reports the first ten-day strike’s announced final day as 28 February (S035). On 1 March the Defensoría describes a “new” 15-day strike and additional march call by CONASA (S031). The preserved original boundary is an announced strike start, not a verified physical assembly onset. No March assembly or physical end of February street actions is established. Do not carry a continuous-episode designation across the boundary without date- and location-specific evidence.
